We isolate $x$ by applying the addition and multiplication principles, as usual.

First, we multiply by $2$ to eliminate the fraction:

$$
\begin{aligned}-1 & <\frac{6x-8}{2}<1 \\ -1\cdot 2 & <\frac{6x-8}{2}\cdot 2<1\cdot 2 \\ -2 & <6x-8<2\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we continue isolating $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-2 & <6x-8<2 \\ -2+8 & <6x-8+8<2+8 \\ 6 & <6x<10 \\ \frac{6}{6} & <\frac{6x}{6}<\frac{10}{6} \\ 1 & <x<\frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $1<x<\frac{5}{3}.$
